## B. Spec & Research Updates

- **leanSpec as minimal client** (Thomas): Adding P2P, signing, and genesis loader components to leanSpec (no external dependencies, not using libp2p). Goal: enable direct experimentation with new P2P protocols without modifying core spec. Removed unused code, simplified structure.
- **Key generation optimization**: PR from community contributor using NumPy/Poseidon permutation for significant speedup without degrading spec. To be merged.
- **Claude AI agents** (Thomas): Set up Claude Code agents in leanSpec repo (`.claude/` folder with sub-agents for documentation, Python code compliance checking, test verification). Public and modifiable by all contributors.
- **Committee aggregation spec**: Draft PR from Kamil in progress.
- **Justification compression**: Spec PR from Zeam team to prune justifications vector before finalized checkpoint. Under review, targeting Devnet-2 inclusion.
- **End-to-end recursion achieved** (Emil): Lean VM simple/M branch now has working recursion. Current performance: **1.3 seconds for 2-to-1 recursion**. Significant optimizations expected.

## C. Devnet-3 Planning

- **[PR #56](https://github.com/leanEthereum/pm/pull/56)** (Unnawut): High-level plan summarizing Gajinder/Kamil discussions. Key uncertainty: slot intervals table for proposer/attester/aggregator roles.
- **Aggregator timing** (Kamil explanation):
  - Validators can opt-in as aggregators
  - Interval 2: aggregate if >X% of committee signatures collected
  - Interval 3: aggregate with whatever signatures available (fallback)
- **[PR #58](https://github.com/leanEthereum/pm/pull/58)** (Kamil): Introduces `compute_subnet_id()` function instead of static assignment in validator config. More aligned with Beacon Chain approach; enables future randomization.
- **Consensus**: Update slot intervals table as PRs merge; Kamil's proposals will drive spec evolution.

## D. Devnet-1 Retrospective & Long-Running Devnet

- **Katya updates**:
  - Testing sync functionality (shutdown/restart scenarios)
  - Raised [Devnet-2 readiness issue](https://github.com/leanEthereum/lean-quickstart/issues) for client Docker images
  - Shared dashboards not ready yet (coming soon)
  - New client integration examples shared in chat
  - Proposal: add commit hash metadata to Docker images for easier identification
- **Retrospective document**: Still in draft, will include sync findings and be published in leanQuickStart repo.
- **Stability discussion**: Devnet still unstable when clients drop (losing 2+ clients → lose finality → restart required). Checkpoint sync expected to improve this significantly.

## E. Dynamic Validator Set Discussion

- **Context**: [PR from Zepturo](https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanSpec/pull/XX) adding deposit/exit interface.
- **Concerns raised**:
  - Fluctuating validator set → dynamic 2/3 fork choice calculation
  - Adds complexity at a stage where devnets aren't stable yet
  - Tooling PR could cause merge conflicts as spec evolves rapidly
- **Resolution**: Defer to Devnet-4 or later. Don't merge tooling now—revisit when planning Lean hard fork parity with full Beacon spec (including DAS, execution, etc.).
- **Workaround for stability**: leanQuickStart allows reassigning validators to different client instances without dynamic validator sets. With checkpoint sync working, switching clients mid-devnet should work smoothly.
